title: Typographic Posters
description: The left poster, expressive type, was created using only letters. There aren't any random lines or shapes in the canvas. I was required to use sans serif, pixel, and script fonts, and I was only allowed to use letters 0.5in or smaller, or 10in or larger. It was quite the challenge but I depicted the word "vex" with bees. Really because I'm a Bridgerton lover. The right poster, systematic type, was free in terms of what fonts we chose. However we were assigned the content that needed to go into it. My poster is for a Savannah documentary festival, there was a lot of copy that needed to be included. I chose a clean, easy to read sans serif for all of the content, and a bold title font that looked like a film title.

title: Elysian
description: Fun fact, I modeled for this piece all by myself. I wrapped a skirt around myself and edited about 6 photos together to achieve this reference photo. Its main form is based on roman busts, while the drapery aspect of it is based on classical marble sculptures. This piece went to Texas VASE State my senior year of high school.

title: Fish Screwdriver
description: I physically created this screwdriver through a series of many many steps. I first 3D modelled concepts for my handle design. After, I created low density foam models before moving onto a medium density foam model. There was a lot of carving and sanding during this project. I then had to fill and seal my medium density foam model to prep it for casting. I made a two part silicone mold which did not want to come apart. I then cast the resin handle before drilling a hole in it to attach the screwdriver shank. A labor of love my little fish was.

title: Ruby
size: Colored Pencil and Alcohol Marker, 6x6 in
description: I experimented with extreme facial expressions in order to better understand form. This is a small self portrait study in red.

title: Remnants
description: Pulling from the porcelain designs of my heritage, I wanted to include patterns and a shattered aspect to this piece. There's also the message of being able to rebuild yourself after facing hardship. I like to look at this piece and think that no matter how fragile life is we should always find ways to savor every moment. This piece went to Texas VASE State my senior year of high school.

title: Mantis
description: I love bugs, especially praying mantis'. This piece plays with sharp contrasts in complimentary colors and splitting form while only using an inversion in color to identify that. There are three different species of mantis in the image, the orchid mantis, the spiny flower mantis, and the banded flower mantis.

title: Psyche
description: I wanted to find a way to visually convey making a decision. I feel like I'm constantly pulled in many directions and it's hard to choose between things. Especially when it comes to what to eat for dinner, that hand is in there somewhere.
